name: Orbwarden · Gremlet #38
description:
A round patrol drone that drifts the same slow loop every day, trailing the vines that grew on it.

One of 50 one-of-a-kind Gremlets. Owning this token unlocks Orbwarden in the Gremlets desktop app, where it walks on your windows, naps, plays with other Gremlets and shows off its signature move.
